meta.purpose: Attribute -> candidate atoms. A change in an attribute lights up the atoms that depend on it. Three indexes: raw name, semantic cluster, and encoding.
meta.reachability: every atom is reachable; see tier. 0 today, 1 needs a scalar sensor, 2 needs the ATTR split, 3 needs objects in the loop, 4 needs a frame-level regularity.
meta.caution: Most raw attribute names appear on exactly one atom, so raw-name intersection returns almost nothing. Use by_cluster for intersection queries.
meta.encoding: ASCII except accented letters in cited names

SCALAR_DEFAULT.why: one integer per object -- same shape as colour; needs the sensor to emit it

SCALAR.why: one integer per object -- same shape as colour; needs the sensor to emit it

TEMPORAL.why: a difference across frames; history() already carries the frames

EVENT.why: what happened between two frames; changed (sensor 9) computes it

BEHAVIOURAL.why: inferred from an observed action sequence over two objects

RELATION.why: two objects; needs objects in the loop and the predicate residual

STATE.why: a discrete condition; an integer with no order

RULE.why: a regularity over frames, not a property of an object
